subject.title: fix(msteams): reset sessions on app removal lifecycle

question: Should `resetSessionEntryLifecycle` become a supported public Plugin SDK/runtime contract, or should this Teams fix use a bundled-only internal seam?
rationale: The runtime mechanics are well tested, but publishing a new third-party session-lifecycle API permanently defines ownership, locking, callback, and compatibility semantics that automation cannot approve.

options.title: Approve the generic public contract
options.body: Keep the documented owner-coordinated API, resolve the main-branch conflict, and land the proven Teams consumer with its contract tests.

options.title: Keep the seam internal
options.body: Refactor the reset operation behind a bundled-only host capability while preserving the Teams behavior and focused lifecycle tests.

options.title: Pause the direction
options.body: Leave the bug and PR open until maintainers are ready to commit to either API boundary.

recommendation.title: Approve the generic public contract
recommendation.body: Keep the documented owner-coordinated API, resolve the main-branch conflict, and land the proven Teams consumer with its contract tests.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Teams persisted-state history, direct participation in scoping this branch, and tracker routing make this the strongest available decision owner.
